det.analysis:
❌ ① 유효: did not meet criteria
❌ ② 동시 고려: 본문 주제 아님
✅ ③ 기준 미달 중단: 핵심 요지 ←정답
❌ ④ 오늘날 유효: 중단됨
det.tip: put to an end because did not meet criteria

ch: 광고 교환은 수익 인식 원칙에 부합하는 유효한 관행이다.
투자자들은 순이익과 수익 성장을 동시에 고려해야 한다.
수익을 부풀리기 위한 광고 교환은 회계 기준에 미달하여 중단되었다.
닷컴 기업의 수익 모델은 오늘날에도 유효하다.

questions.passage: Many early dot-com investors __________ instead of net income. Many early dot-com companies earned most of their revenue from selling advertising space on their Web sites. To boost reported revenue, some sites began exchanging ad space. Company A would put an ad for its Web site on company B’s Web site, and company B would put an ad for its Web site on company A’s Web site. No money ever changed hands, but each company recorded revenue (for the value of the space that it gave up on its site) and expense (for the value of its ad that it placed on the other company’s site). This practice did little to boost net income and __________________________ — but it did boost reported revenue. This practice was quickly put to an end because accountants felt that it did not meet the criteria of the revenue recognition principle.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오.
"거의 전적으로 수익 성장에 집중했다"
[조건] (1) focused, almost, entirely, on, revenue, growth를 모두 사용 (2) 6단어로 쓸 것 (6단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 거의 전적으로 수익 성장에 집중했다
det.analysis: 원문: focused almost entirely on revenue growth instead of net income
det.tip: focus on = ~에 집중하다

questions.wa: focused almost entirely on revenue growth
accept: focused almost entirely on revenue growth
